description: This file defines a dashboard dashlet class for a specific module in the SuiteCRM project. It extends DashletGeneric and initializes properties like title, search fields, columns, and seedBean based on module-specific data and metadata.

classes.name: <module_name>Dashlet
classes.description: Represents a custom dashlet for the specified module in SuiteCRM, extending the generic Dashlet class and setting module-specific properties.
